benign.title: Tilt after big losses
benign.text: One player enters +30% more pots right after a big loss (more than 92% of pairs). Reckless play while tilting can look like chip dumping.

benign.title: Too few hands to be sure
benign.text: They played only 2% of the table's hands together (fewer than 90% of pairs). A few big pots can swing every rate; treat the scores as weak evidence.
